Name: Judas, Brother of Jesus
Summary: Judas was one of the brothers of Jesus named by the people of Nazareth. He is distinct from Judas Iscariot, Judas son of James, Judas Barsabbas, and Judas of Galilee, and is traditionally identified with Jude, the author of the letter of Jude.
KeyStory: Nazareth named Judas among Jesus' brothers, one more familiar name that could not see the Messiah at home.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; James, Brother of Jesus; Mary, Mother of Jesus
LifeLesson: The family that grew up with Jesus had to learn to worship Him. Blood ties do not save; belief does.
